plan.name: S3K title roll-in, whole width, no move
plan.why: Unchanged: black for 0.55 s (the SEGA logo is never shown), then the smear frames, native flash, logo drop, wink.

plan.name: Launch Base 1: MICA and TALON cross the bridge at full speed, spring launch
plan.why: Was a run from a standstill (mean |gspeed| 863). Same act, started further back so both are at top speed (1536) on the first frame; name tags a beat apart; the spring fires on beat 4 of bar 3 and the cut follows the launch.

restage.target: both at |gspeed| 1536 for the whole shot; spring on bar 3 beat 4
restage.probe: start x about 13500-14000 on the same floor, R held on both pads
restage.fallback: q-walk-14500 #112-222 as a 1.3-bar shot behind a longer roll-in hold

plan.name: Angel Island 1: carry swoop. MICA jumps from a run, TALON catches her in the air and carries her on
plan.why: Was 4 bars with TALON walking up to a standing MICA, then a slow vertical climb (mean speed 2.5 px/f, no interaction after the catch). Now 2 bars: both moving when he catches her, the catch on a beat, then travel across the canopy. Promise line on bar 5.

restage.target: catch on bar 4 beat 3 with MICA airborne from a run; camera travelling at 3 px/f or more after it
restage.probe: pad 2 jumps and flaps toward her while pad 1 runs and jumps (the pair take already steers a carry with L/R)
restage.fallback: the current take from #37 (catch on beat 2), cut at 2 bars

plan.name: Angel Island 1: TALON divebombs a Rhinobot
plan.why: One bar. Was a pane of the verbs triptych; here it is his first hit, full frame, on the beat.

plan.name: Angel Island 1: MICA strikes the second Rhinobot, jade trail
plan.why: One bar. Her first hit, a beat pattern with the shot before: his hit on beat 3 of bar 6, hers on beat 3 of bar 7.

plan.name: Mushroom Hill 1: Hyper MICA through two loops with banded after-images
plan.why: Replaces the Death Egg Hyper fragment, which showed the same kill twice in the film (here and at bar 77). The loops are the fastest picture on disk: 10.5 px/f, camera 700 px/s.

plan.name: Sonic 2 title: MICA then TALON rise over the emblem
plan.why: Unchanged; the native flash still lands on the drop (bar 12).

plan.name: Title flash on the drop, lock-up band, names pop a beat apart
plan.why: Hold cut from 4 bars to 2: glint on bar 13, out on bar 14.

plan.name: Marble Garden 2: lock-on, three Mantises in one flight (100, 200, 500)
plan.why: Same take, two bars earlier. First kill on beat 4 of bar 14; the next two are 4 and 3 frames early of the following beats, to be tuned to 21-frame gaps in stage B. Ends before she is hurt (#183).

restage.target: kills on bar 14 beat 4, bar 15 beats 1 and 2
restage.probe: delay the second and third strike presses by 4 and 1 frames
restage.fallback: the take as it is (4 and 3 frames early)

plan.name: Slanted triptych: the strike in Sonic 1, Sonic 2, Sonic 3 & K
plan.why: Cut from 4 bars to 2. Slices drop on beats 1, 2, 3; the three strikes land on beats 3, 4 and the next downbeat, a 1-2-3.

plan.name: Hydrocity 1: rolling through the curved channel at speed, out on the spring
plan.why: New. A loop at speed; the cut out is the spring launch.

plan.name: Chemical Plant 1: spindash rev, release off the ledge
plan.why: New, one bar. The release fires on beat 2 and she drops through the plant at 11 px/f. (After #137 this take slows to a walk, so it stops at one bar.)

plan.name: Green Hill 1 (Sonic 1): downhill at top speed
plan.why: New, one bar: Sonic 1 in the speed run, so the block is not all Sonic 2.

plan.name: Emerald Hill 2: corkscrew, then the side spring
plan.why: New. Spring on beat 3 of bar 23.

plan.name: Mushroom Hill 1: mushroom spring into the canopy, ring arc
plan.why: New. Spring on beat 3; seven rings in half a second.

plan.name: Casino Night 1: MICA and TALON bounce through the bumpers
plan.why: Same take as now, moved 131 frames later: the current window ends as the bumpers start. Four bumper hits within 6 frames of beats.

restage.probe: shift the leap by a few frames

plan.name: Spring Yard 1: flight, lock-on, two Crabmeats (100, 200); lives read TALON
plan.why: Cut from 4 bars to 2. The kills are 42 frames apart, exactly two beats: beat 4 of bar 28 and beat 2 of bar 29. Lives inset on beat 3. He lands and runs at top speed to the cut.

plan.name: Hill Top 1: divebomb streak across the lake
plan.why: Replaces the slow flight pane (mean speed 3.2 px/f, nothing touched). The dive starts on beat 2 and reaches 24 px/f; camera 625 px/s.

plan.name: Death Egg 1: dive, land, run into the booster
plan.why: Replaces the carry pane, which repeated the cold open. Booster on beat 3 of bar 33.

plan.name: Aquatic Ruin 1: TALON divebombs two Whisps in a row
plan.why: New. His Sonic 2 hits, on the two bars before the drop. He has kills in Sonic 1 and Sonic 3 & K on disk but none in Sonic 2.

restage.target: kills on bar 34 beat 3 and bar 35 beat 1
restage.probe: TALON solo at the position of MICA's Whisp take (8300, 860)
restage.fallback: Launch Base 1 flight over the dome (f-lbz1-talon #109-277), no kill

plan.name: Lockstep split, Chemical Plant 1: run, jump, roll
plan.why: The 1.5 s of look-up and duck (speed 0) is cut out: the split now plays two moving bars with a cut on bar 37.

plan.name: Lockstep split: spindash release into the spring
plan.why: Release on beat 2 in both halves. The line lands here.

plan.name: Lockstep split, Emerald Hill 1 at top speed
plan.why: New window from takes on disk: the same inputs at 7.4 px/f. From the act start (TIME 0:11), as the Chemical Plant split is; a positioned mid-act pair will be tried in stage B.

plan.name: Slanted triptych: the three title screens
plan.why: Cut from 4 bars to 2; slices on beats 1, 2, 3.

plan.name: Signposts spin and land on MICA: Sonic 1 and Sonic 2
plan.why: Was 2 bars of running in and standing (idle 2.0 s and 1.4 s). Now one bar that starts mid-spin; both signs land on her face on beat 4.

plan.name: Sonic 2 tally: MICA GOT THROUGH flies in
plan.why: Was 2 bars, static after the fly-in. Now the fly-in only.

plan.name: Slanted triptych: the three special stages
plan.why: Cut from 4 bars to 2; slices on beats 1, 2, 3.

plan.name: 2x2: Continue, Data Select, special-stage HUD names, lives TALON
plan.why: Cut from 3 bars to 2; cells pop on beats 1 to 4 of bar 46.

plan.name: Sky Chase: MICA strikes three badniks from the wing; TALON pilots
plan.why: Cut from 4 bars to 2 and moved next to the ending, so the Tornado plays as one beat. First kill on beat 2; the other two are 3 and 6 frames early of their beats, to be tuned in stage B. Callout on beat 3 of bar 49.

restage.target: kills on bar 48 beat 2, bar 49 beats 1 and 3
restage.probe: stretch the two gaps from 60 and 39 frames to 63 and 42

plan.name: Sonic 2 ending: MICA flies beside the Tornado
plan.why: Was 1.5 bars; one bar.

plan.name: Ending pose: MICA lands on the wing, TALON at the stick
plan.why: Was 2 bars; one bar, the landing on beat 2.

plan.name: Metropolis 1: the fastest normal-form run, 11 px/f
plan.why: New. Opens the build into the chorus.

plan.name: Launch Base 1: down the slope, spring, ring line
plan.why: New. Spring on beat 3.

plan.name: Green Hill 2 (Sonic 1): monitor pop on the low road
plan.why: New window of a take already in the film. One bar.

plan.name: Emerald Hill 2: run-up and a Buzzer struck on the bar
plan.why: New. The kill lands on bar 58; the Gilded run-in starts two beats later.

plan.name: Hydrocity 1: normal MICA jumps, winds up, snaps open gold; Gilded run, spring
plan.why: Cut from 5.5 bars to 3.5. Reveal on the chorus (bar 60) as now; the spring lands on beat 3 of bar 61 and the shot ends on bar 62.

plan.name: Same Rhinobot twice: jade trail above, gold trail below
plan.why: Cut from 3.5 bars to 2; the two strikes land two beats apart.

plan.name: Gilded MICA in Sonic 1: Star Light at speed
plan.why: Was a triptych pane. One bar, full frame.

plan.name: Gilded MICA in Sonic 2: Aquatic Ruin treetops, spring
plan.why: New. 10 px/f; spring on beat 2.

plan.name: Gilded MICA in Sonic 2: gold streak through the Chemical Plant tubes
plan.why: New. Spring on beat 2.

plan.name: Solar TALON: wind-up, flame reveal on bar 68, straight into a divebomb kill on bar 69
plan.why: Was 4.5 bars with 3.5 s of slow hovering after the reveal (mean speed 2.4 px/f, nothing touched). Now 2.5 bars: reveal, then he dives at once and the kill lands a bar later, embers trailing.

restage.target: reveal on bar 68; kill on bar 69
restage.probe: Solar TALON at the Angel Island Rhinobot position (his solar kill take is there): transform within reach, dive on the next bar
restage.fallback: the Carnival Night take to bar 69, then its own fast flight (#190-274) for bar 69-70, a time cut inside the take, disclosed

plan.name: Solar TALON in Death Egg 1: ember flight into the booster
plan.why: New. Booster on beat 2 of bar 71.

plan.name: Solar TALON in Sonic 1: Spring Yard
plan.why: One bar at 7.8 px/f; with the next shot it replaces the slow Mystic Cave pane as the proof in the other two games.

plan.name: Solar TALON in Sonic 2: Hill Top
plan.why: One bar: the dive across the lake, with embers.

plan.name: Solar TALON divebombs a Rhinobot in Angel Island
plan.why: Was a triptych pane with 1.6 s of approach. Full frame, the kill on beat 3 of bar 74.

plan.name: Death Egg 1: Hyper MICA reveal on the lift, one strike, after-image dash
plan.why: Same take and length. The kill now sits exactly on bar 77; the reveal is then 4 frames early of bar 76. In stage B the strike press moves 4 frames earlier so both land.

restage.target: reveal on bar 76 and kill on bar 77
restage.fallback: kill on the bar, reveal 4 frames early

plan.name: Launch Base 1 mini-boss: Hyper MICA runs in and strikes once; ONE HIT.
plan.why: She stands and waits 1.4 s for the boss in the current take. Re-staged so she is moving until the hop: back off inside the locked arena, run in as it swings down, strike on bar 79. The card and the revert it covers are unchanged.

restage.probe: after the camera locks: L for about 30 frames, R, jump
restage.fallback: the current take cut in half a bar later (the Death Egg shot runs to 78.5)

plan.name: Launch Base 1: twin transformation, then TALON catches Hyper MICA and flies her across the skyline
plan.why: The twin reveal on beat 2 stays. Two things change: nobody stands (TALON lifts off on the reveal instead of walking over for 0.8 s), and the carry travels across the towers instead of rising in place (now 1 px/f, camera 66 px/s).

restage.target: reveal on bar 80 beat 2, catch on bar 81, then 3 px/f of travel to the end card
restage.probe: start about 650 px left of the starpost on the open bridge so the carry can fly right for 3 bars; hold R with the flaps

plan.name: Lock-up, line, URL, disclaimer over the pair take; music fades bars 85-88
plan.why: Unchanged.
